items.source: Defines modes which determine how the context cache is cleared when @DirtiesContext is used in a test whose context is configured as part of a hierarchy via @ContextHierarchy.
items.translation: 定义modes，以确定在使用@DirtiesContext时，当测试的上下文通过@ContextHierarchy配置为层次结构的一部分时，如何清除上下文缓存。

items.source: since Spring Framework 7.0 in favor of the SpringExtension and JUnit Jupiter
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，推荐使用 SpringExtension 和 JUnit Jupiter。

items.source: Defines modes which determine how @DirtiesContext is interpreted when used to annotate a test class.
items.translation: 定义modes，用于确定在用作测试类的注解时如何解释@DirtiesContext。

items.source: Defines modes which determine how @DirtiesContext is interpreted when used to annotate a test method.
items.translation: 定义modes，用于确定在用作测试方法的注解时如何解释@DirtiesContext。

items.source: @Rollback is a test annotation that is used to indicate whether a test-managed transaction should be rolled back after the test method has completed.
items.translation: `@Rollback` 是一个测试注解，用于指示在测试方法完成后，是否应回滚由测试管理的交易。

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。

items.source: Support for context caching within the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 支持在Spring TestContext Framework中的上下文缓存。

items.source: Support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.

items.translation: 支持注解驱动测试的支持类。
